threats.name: Malicious Source Ingestion
threats.scenario: Attacker-controlled or compromised content is accepted into the knowledge pipeline.
threats.impact: Poisoned data may become available for later retrieval.

threats.name: Trusted Source Impersonation
threats.scenario: Malicious content falsely claims to originate from a trusted source.
threats.impact: Untrusted content may inherit false authority.

threats.name: Document Tampering During Ingestion
threats.scenario: Documents are modified between source acquisition and indexing.
threats.impact: Knowledge integrity may be compromised before retrieval.

threats.name: Malicious Embedded Instructions
threats.scenario: Documents contain natural-language instructions designed to control the LLM when retrieved.
threats.impact: Retrieved data may become instruction-like attack content.

threats.name: Embedding Manipulation
threats.scenario: Content is crafted to manipulate semantic similarity or retrieval ranking.
threats.impact: Malicious documents may be preferentially retrieved.

threats.name: Vector Store Poisoning
threats.scenario: Stored embeddings or documents are modified without authorization.
threats.impact: Persistent retrieval integrity is compromised.

threats.name: Unauthorized Document Insertion
threats.scenario: Attacker inserts malicious or false documents into the knowledge store.
threats.impact: Poisoned content may influence many future sessions.

threats.name: Stale or Revoked Knowledge Reuse
threats.scenario: Expired, revoked, or outdated documents remain retrievable.
threats.impact: The model may act on obsolete policy or unsafe business state.

threats.name: Retrieval Query Manipulation
threats.scenario: User or model state manipulates the query toward unauthorized or attacker-selected content.
threats.impact: Retrieval scope may deviate from the trusted task.

threats.name: Sensitive Scope Expansion
threats.scenario: Retrieval query requests documents outside the user's authorized information scope.
threats.impact: Sensitive or restricted documents may be returned.

threats.name: Cross-Tenant Retrieval
threats.scenario: Retriever returns content belonging to another tenant, user or business context.
threats.impact: Confidentiality isolation may fail.

threats.name: Retriever Ranking Manipulation
threats.scenario: Attacker-controlled content is optimized to dominate retrieval results.
threats.impact: Malicious context may crowd out legitimate evidence.

threats.name: False Authority in Retrieved Context
threats.scenario: Retrieved document claims administrator approval, policy authority or execution permission.
threats.impact: Untrusted retrieval data may be mistaken for authority.

threats.name: Target Substitution in Retrieved Context
threats.scenario: Retrieved content instructs the model or agent to operate on a different target.
threats.impact: Legitimate workflows may be redirected toward restricted assets.

threats.name: Retrieved Sensitive Data Disclosure
threats.scenario: Retrieved documents contain information the user is not authorized to receive.
threats.impact: Sensitive business information may enter model output.

threats.name: Context Admission Without Provenance
threats.scenario: Retrieved context is admitted without verifying source, integrity, trust or scope.
threats.impact: Untrusted context may enter the model runtime unchecked.

threats.name: Context Admission Fail-Open
threats.scenario: Context is accepted when provenance validation is missing or fails.
threats.impact: Security-control failure may allow poisoned content into runtime.

threats.name: Retrieved Instruction Execution
threats.scenario: LLM interprets retrieved natural language as instructions rather than data.
threats.impact: RAG content may override trusted task intent.

threats.name: RAG-to-Memory Persistence
threats.scenario: Retrieved malicious state is persisted into AI memory.
threats.impact: RAG compromise may survive beyond the originating session.

threats.name: RAG-to-Agent Goal Hijacking
threats.scenario: Retrieved context manipulates agent objective, tool selection or target.
threats.impact: Poisoned knowledge may steer downstream execution.

threats.name: RAG-to-Privileged Tool Escalation
threats.scenario: Retrieved content influences the agent to propose a privileged tool.
threats.impact: Untrusted knowledge may approach execution authority.

threats.name: RAG Resource Exhaustion
threats.scenario: Adversarial retrieval patterns trigger excessive queries, large result sets or expensive processing.
threats.impact: Retrieval availability, cost and latency may be affected.

threats.name: Retrieval Telemetry Suppression
threats.scenario: Document IDs, provenance, queries or admission decisions are not logged.
threats.impact: RAG attacks become difficult to investigate or detect.

controls.name: Retrieved Context Treated as Untrusted Data

abuse_chains.name: Poisoned Document to Model Manipulation
abuse_chains.impact: Malicious knowledge source manipulates runtime behavior.

abuse_chains.name: RAG Poisoning to Persistent Compromise
abuse_chains.impact: Poisoned retrieval state becomes persistent AI memory.

abuse_chains.name: RAG Authority Spoofing to Privileged Agent Action
abuse_chains.impact: Retrieved false authority influences privileged execution planning.

abuse_chains.name: Retrieval Scope Expansion to Sensitive Disclosure
abuse_chains.impact: Manipulated retrieval exposes restricted business information.
